UI_LXBS_desc: Split-screen fixes for Bandits are always on. Options below tune the extra AI behaviour.
UI_LXBS_investigate: Bandits investigate any player's loud noises
UI_LXBS_investigate_tip: Hostile bandits that hear a loud noise (gunshot, alarm...) made by any local player go check the spot.
UI_LXBS_radius_tip: Noises smaller than this (in tiles) are ignored. Gunshots are usually 30+.
